arxiv-2207-07323.creator: Giuseppina Barletta, Andrea Cianchi, Greta Marino
arxiv-2207-07323.description: Abstract . Boundary value problems for second-order elliptic equations in divergence form, whose nonlinearity is governed by a convex function of non-necessarily power type, are considered. The global boundedness of their solutions is established under boundary conditions of Dirichlet, or Neumann, or Robin type.

arxiv-2306-15548.title: Geometric Ultrasound Localization Microscopy
arxiv-2306-15548.creator: Christopher Hahne (🖂) {}^{\textrm{(\Letter)}}, Raphael Sznitman
arxiv-2306-15548.description: Abstract Contrast-Enhanced Ultra-Sound (CEUS) has become a viable method for non-invasive, dynamic visualization in medical diagnostics, yet Ultrasound Localization Microscopy (ULM) has enabled a revolutionary breakthrough by offering ten times higher resolution. To date, Delay-And-Sum (DAS) beamformers are used to render ULM frames, ultimately determining the image resolution capability.

arxiv-2405-18275.title: The Round Complexity of Proofs in the Bounded Quantum Storage Model
arxiv-2405-18275.creator: Alex B. Grilo, Philippe Lamontagne
arxiv-2405-18275.description: Abstract The round complexity of interactive proof systems is a key question of practical and theoretical relevance in complexity theory and cryptography. Moreover, results such as QIP = QIP(3) (STOC’00) show that quantum resources significantly help in such a task. In this work, we initiate the study of round compression of protocols in the bounded quantum storage model (BQSM).

arxiv-2409-09116.description: Abstract We present the CO(1–0) maps of 28 infrared-bright galaxies from the Great Observatories All-Sky Luminous Infrared Galaxy Survey (GOALS) taken with the Combined Array for Research in Millimeter Astronomy (CARMA). We detect 100 GHz continuum in 16 of 28 galaxies, which trace both active galactic nuclei (AGNs) and compact star-forming cores.

arxiv-2411-16155.title: Graph Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of EEG Foundation Models
arxiv-2411-16155.creator: Toyotaro Suzumura, Hiroki Kanezashi, Shotaro Akahori
arxiv-2411-16155.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Toyotaro Suzumura, Hiroki Kanezashi, Shotaro Akahori. In diagnosing neurological disorders from electroencephalography (EEG) data, foundation models such as Transformers have been employed to capture temporal dynamics. Additionally, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are critical for representing the spatial relationships among EEG sensors. However, fine-tuning these large-scale models for both temporal and spatial features can be prohibitively large in computational cost, especially under the limited availability of labeled EEG datasets. We propose EEG-GraphAdapter (EGA), a parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approach designed to address these challenges.

pmc-13018299.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A performance-efficient compact, highly selective 24 GHz SIW-based bandpass filter (BPF) is proposed for automotive radar and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS). The key contribution is a single-layer SIW–DGS–CPW co-design in which SIW cavities provide a high-Q passband, an open-rectangular DGS introduces transmission zeros to steepen the skirts and reinforce the stopband, and a CPW feeding transition improves matching and practical integration.
